criticisms.claim: '-w same worktree name' re-dispatch makes the worker 'see its own prior commits and STATUS.md' — false; every dispatch builds a FRESH worktree from HEAD
criticisms.evidence: branch dispatch.sh:140-144 WT_PATH="$DISPATCH_ROOT/$WORKTREE_NAME-$STAMP", WT_BRANCH="dispatch/$WORKTREE_NAME-$STAMP"; :175 git worktree add -b "$WT_BRANCH" "$WT_PATH" HEAD. -w is only a name PREFIX.
criticisms.suggested_fix: re-dispatch = fresh worktree from HEAD; carry work forward by merge/cherry-pick of dispatch/<name>-<stamp> or by pasting STATUS.md + diff into the ticket.

criticisms.claim: Ticket template contradicts itself: header demands stage commits + STATUS.md, delivery protocol still demands ONE 'commit ALL work'
criticisms.evidence: ticket-self-contradiction class introduced by the same commit that tightened rule 3
criticisms.suggested_fix: Delivery protocol step 3 → commit at every checkpoint; final commit message <TICKET-ID>: <summary>.

criticisms.claim: Dispatch header (ETA/¥, 'AC 已亲跑', owner phrasing) rides the worker prompt verbatim — commander bookkeeping leaks into the worker's instructions and imposes budget pressure
criticisms.suggested_fix: commander-only fields to a sidecar; only worker-actionable checkpoint/STATUS lines in the ticket.

criticisms.claim: Skill is staged on main but every ds mechanic exists only on the branch worktree; the skill flags only the header-lint as branch-pending
criticisms.suggested_fix: state that main's dispatch.sh is grok-only until FF.

criticisms.claim: 'Verification before any claim' defines receipt as command+exit+numbers — document tickets have no command; '待验证 → not entered in the ledger' contradicts 'never silently drop'
criticisms.evidence: panel evidence vocabulary at :37 already accepts file:line / PDF quotes
criticisms.suggested_fix: receipt per artifact type; pending findings enter the ledger with status=pending.

criticisms.claim: 'optional' is an undefined fourth bucket overlapping minor, and a downgrade loophole hiding contract-fault and authority errors
criticisms.suggested_fix: define optional; downgrade-because-AC-silent triggers contract-fault check; authority errors recorded regardless.

criticisms.claim: 'dispatch.sh handles --max-turns' false; usage advertises -n/-t/-e without saying ds rejects them; 'effort pinned to top tier' is grok residue
criticisms.suggested_fix: mark grok-only; ds has no effort dial.

criticisms.claim: resume-worker.sh ds-specific instruction is effectively dead code (dies earlier on missing camelCase sessionId)
criticisms.suggested_fix: soften skill wording to 'refuses ds/cursor envelopes'.

criticisms.claim: 'open item on branch' for the header lint is not tracked anywhere
paragraph forbidding unreceipted claims opens with unreceipted numbers (291, PTCG v9/v22/v24/v25) and private-path references in a public-facing repo
criticisms.evidence: no source attached; PTCG is another private project
criticisms.suggested_fix: cite or generalize; drop private path.

criticisms.claim: STATUS.md heartbeat / stage commits shift reporting cost onto the pay-per-use worker; 'commander polls in background' is not scripted
criticisms.evidence: dispatch.sh synchronous; no poller; no STATUS.md concept in any script
criticisms.suggested_fix: pin STATUS.md to .scratch/dispatch/<id>/; referee excludes it; polling is a manual commander duty.

criticisms.claim: 'schema-constrained JSON receipt' overstates the ds seam — dsh emits plain text; receipt is last JSON object validated post-hoc

what_is_good: dsh claims verified offline against cached 0.1.0-rc.6 binary (--profile headless has no --cwd/--json-schema/--model/--max-turns/--resume; --patch is launcher-level; default model deepseek-v4-flash)
key-source instruction and balance warning match dispatch.sh:119-124
contract-freeze hard-fail, SIGPIPE trap, tripwire, model gate, -k revival all match
receipt_prompt_suffix() exists and says what rule 6 claims
'facts in commander memory are invisible to the worker — paste them' is a genuine addition
skill honest that header fields are unenforced; grok --resume text correctly removed
